Messages.Author: devilwithcape
Messages.Body:
Ok, so I understand why guard duty won't give you the untap or +1
intercept if someone is trying to do a (D) action at your location at
0 stealth, as per the rule book.

What I don't understand is how can vampires with +1 stealth and +1
intercept get those bonuses when they're not needed. Or, how someone
with a Bowl of Convergence gets the intercept before it's need. Can
someone explain this to me?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jan 5, 2:18 pm, devilwithcape


He doesn't add +1 intercept; he *has* +1 intercept. Those effects are
"on" when the action starts. The rule prohibits adding more when it
isn't needed -- it doesn't prevent existing stealth/intercept from
coming along.

See also hunting's default +1 stealth.
